title: A Park and a Library
text:
There is a park near my house. It is big and green. Many people walk there in the morning.

Next to the park there is a library. My sister goes there every Saturday to read books. The library is open until six.

questions.text: When does my sister go to the library?
What kind of place is the park probably?
What can you probably do at the library?

vocabulary.definition: a green public area where people walk and play
a place where you can borrow and read books
not closed, so people can go in

paragraph_translations: Hay un parque cerca de mi casa. Es grande y verde. Muchas personas caminan allí por la mañana.
Al lado del parque hay una biblioteca. Mi hermana va allí todos los sábados para leer libros. La biblioteca está abierta hasta las seis.
